meta_description: Registration for the XUNTAS+XUNTOS Development Program. 2026–2027 cycle.
gate_lede: We ask this first for a reason: if you are a minor, your parent or guardian has to authorize the creation of your account. This way we ask them from the start and not halfway through.
gate_date_implausible: Check the date, it looks wrong.
gate_minor_text: We need your parent's or guardian's details. There is no document to upload: they will get an email to authorize your account with one click.
gate_guardian_email_same: Your guardian's email can't be your own.
gate_guardian_help: The authorization goes to this email. Make sure it's spelled correctly.
account_lede: With your account you can save a half-finished registration and come back later. You can edit whenever you want until September 18.
account_no_password: We don't use passwords. Sign in with Google or with a code sent to your email.
reg_lede: A single door. You don't apply for a scholarship: you apply to belong. Everyone who registers is automatically considered by the Technical Council.
reg_brief_text: At this stage we don't ask for a swing video, medical certificate, coach letters, academic records, or birth certificates and IDs. Those shortlisted for a scholarship will be asked for the full file later.
reg_s1_sub: This tells us who to reach out to.
reg_s2_sub: If you are in the college placement process, note it in the grade field.
reg_coach_error: Tell us who your coach is.
reg_status_pro: Professional · I aspire to Xunt@s Pro
reg_status_help: Amateur status is governed by the IGF Nationality Policy and the Rules of the USGA and The R&A. It does not apply to Xunt@s Pro.
reg_ghin_error: Enter your current index or equivalent.
reg_s4_sub: Your most representative tournaments. Add as many as you like; three is enough to start.
reg_s5_sub: Only the ones that apply to you. Leave the rest blank.
reg_s6_sub: The tournaments you plan to play in the coming months.
reg_s7_sub: One page at most, written by you. Don't let your coach or family write it: we want to read you.
reg_ck_rules: I accept the terms of the call for applications
reg_ck_rules_sub: I understand that registering does not guarantee admission or a scholarship, and that the Technical Council's decisions are final.
reg_ck_scholarship: I understand that the scholarship is not applied for, it is awarded
reg_ck_scholarship_sub: By registering I am automatically considered. There is no separate scholarship application form.
reg_ck_privacy_sub: My data is used for the program's evaluation, follow-up, and reporting.
reg_closing: The registration period closes on September 18, 2026.
reg_closed: The registration period is closed. It closed on September 18, 2026.
done_review: We will review your registration before September 23, 2026.
done_editable: You can edit your details until September 18 at 11:59 PM, Central Mexico time.
guardian_missing_text: We sent them an email to authorize your account. Your registration is saved, but it isn't complete until they confirm.
guardian_wait: Wait a few minutes before resending.
guardian_confirmed: Your guardian has authorized your account.
authorize_ok_text: Thank you. The account can now complete its registration. You don't need to do anything else.
authorize_already_text: There is nothing else to do.
authorize_expired_text: Ask the person who registered to resend you the email from their dashboard, or write to us.
authorize_invalid_text: Check that you copied the full link from the email.
account_closed_text: The 2026–2027 General Call for Applications opens on September 4, 2026.
sync_text: It takes a few seconds. This screen refreshes on its own as soon as it's ready; no need to reload.
sync_help: If you're still seeing this after a minute, write to us and we'll sort it out.
age_missing_text: Your account is missing a date of birth. We need it before you can submit your registration: it determines whether your parent's or guardian's authorization is required.
guardian_too_many: Too many emails have already been sent to your guardian. Write to us at hola@xuntas.org and we'll sort it out with you.
rules_title: Terms of the call for applications
doc_draft_title: This document is not final yet
doc_draft_text: XUNTAS is still finishing the wording. What you see here is a scaffold with the sections it will have, not the final text. If you have questions before registering, write to us at hola@xuntas.org.
error_text: It's not your fault and your draft is safe: the form saves itself as you type. Reload the page and you should find everything where you left it. If it happens again, write to us at hola@xuntas.org.
nf_text: The link may have arrived cut off. If it was shared with you over WhatsApp, ask them to send it again in full.
